newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy says reaches pact on dispute.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy says reaches pact on dispute.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said Tuesday it has reached a preliminary agreement with Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co to settle a dispute over natural gas supply realignment costs.

The terms of the agreement are to remain confidential until a settlement document is filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, El Paso Energy said. The document is expected to be filed in early to mid-January, it said.

El Paso Chairman, President and Chief Executive William Wise said in a statement that the total gas supply realignment amount "to be shared between the pipeline and its customers has been capped at just under $1.2 billion."
The agreement in principle also is contingent upon the completion of a previously announced merger of Tenneco Inc's Tenneco Energy and El Paso, the company said.
The merger is expected to be completed by mid-December. If the merger is not consummated before April 1, 1997, then Tennessee has the option to terminate the preliminary agreement, the company said.
